name: 79235 · Floydada, TX
findings: ZIP 79235 (Floydada) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79235 (Floydada) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
